accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project — JICA
AP Irrigation and Livelihood Project Phase-II — JICA
South Asia Poverty Alleviation Programme — World Bank
accepted.x: APILIP-II is funded by JICA. APIIATP is funded by the World Bank, SAPAP by UNDP and VCIC by ADB.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure agency-project pair and eliminate swapped funding agencies.
accepted.sec: Externally aided project → funding agency

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding externally aided projects in Andhra Pradesh:
1. APIIATP is funded by the World Bank.
2. SAPAP is supported by UNDP.
3. The Green Energy Corridor Phase-I is supported by KfW of Germany.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. APIIATP is a World Bank project, SAPAP is supported by UNDP, and Green Energy Corridor Phase-I is funded by KfW.
accepted.tq: Test several agency-project relationships together, using nearby agencies as distractors.
accepted.sec: Externally aided project → funding agency

accepted.s: AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project is associated with which of the following objectives and coverage?
o: Repair of 850 km of major district roads in 13 districts
Industrial development across three corridors covering 33,000 acres
Urban water supply in 123 urban local bodies
Climate resilience and productivity in 565 minor-tank villages across 22 districts
accepted.x: APIIATP focuses on climate resilience and productivity in 565 minor-tank villages spread across 22 districts.
accepted.tq: Match the project with its distinctive coverage figures and objective.
accepted.sec: Externally aided project → funding agency

accepted.s: The AP Integrated Irrigation and Agriculture Transformation Project was scheduled to conclude on:
accepted.x: APIIATP concluded on 31 October 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the exact completion date rather than confusing it with other project timelines.
accepted.sec: Externally aided project → funding agency

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC):
1. It extends for approximately 800 km.
2. It forms part of the East Coast Economic Corridor.
3. It is linked with Act East and Make in India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: VCIC is approximately 800 km long, forms part of the East Coast Economic Corridor, and is linked with Act East and Make in India.
accepted.tq: Use a three-statement combination to test identity, regional linkage and policy linkage.
accepted.sec: ADB projects - VCIC, power, urban water

accepted.s: Which of the following sets consists of the nodes of the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor mentioned in the project description?

accepted.s: The planned investment in VCIC was backed by an ADB loan of approximately:

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (VCIC loan component)
 a. Policy-based loan
 b. Project loan
 c. Programme total
 d. GoAP share in project loan

List-II (Amount or share)
 i. $840 million
 ii. 30 per cent or $215 million
 iii. $125 million
 iv. 70 per cent ADB financing

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The policy-based loan is $125 million, the project loan has 70% ADB financing, the programme total is $840 million, and the GoAP share is 30% or $215 million.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive programme total and then match the financing shares.
accepted.sec: ADB projects - VCIC, power, urban water

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the VCIC loan structure is NOT correct?
o: The policy-based loan was fully financed by ADB.
The policy-based loan amounted to $125 million.
The project loan had 70 per cent ADB financing and 30 per cent GoAP financing.
The GoAP contribution to the project loan was $125 million.
accepted.x: The GoAP contribution to the project loan was $215 million, not $125 million. The policy-based loan of $125 million was fully financed by ADB.
accepted.tq: Use a swapped financial figure to identify the NOT correct statement.
accepted.sec: ADB projects - VCIC, power, urban water
